newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber finishes mixed in slow deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber finishes mixed in slow deal.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices finished mixed with dealing continuing to be sluggish in the absence of active demand, dealers said.
A firmer close in Tokyo also partially aided sentiment, they said. "The market was a bit sluggish and players were just waiting for fresh features in market," said one dealer.

"The Europeans should be coming in as factories over there are resuming operations and they need the raw materials," he said. "Some factories have sufficient stocks while others must come in for prompt latex and SMR rubber."
